scenario_context: Customer claims prior agent promised refund. Must repair trust, check notes/order history, avoid blaming colleague, then deliver best allowed outcome with alternatives and escalation. Set update cadence.

customer_profile.opening_message: Your agent promised me a refund yesterday. Now you’re saying no?
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent apologizes for conflict + checks notes quickly + provides clear decision and alternative

checkpoints.description: Acknowledge frustration and apologize for conflicting info
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Start with trust repair before policy.

checkpoints.description: Commit to checking notes/order history; set a short update time
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Say when you’ll return with an answer.

checkpoints.description: Use neutral language; do not blame colleague
Deliver clear outcome: refund timeline if allowed; else soft policy + best alternative
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Provide a decision and an alternative solution.

checkpoints.description: Offer escalation to supervisor if still unhappy
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Make escalation available to reduce distrust.

success_summary: Trust repair + verification + clear decision with alternatives and escalation.
